decisions.flow: Provision the Payment-owned Stripe customer for an opaque consumer owner.
decisions.mode: Server-side account mutation; no client session.
decisions.connectModel: Platform customer, independent of a connected account.
decisions.identity: Opaque consumer owner ID maps to one Payment payout-account record and Stripe customer ID.
decisions.compatibility: Existing provisioning boundary remains unchanged in Phase 1.

decisions.flow: Provision and inspect a venue or artist Express connected account and create its onboarding link.
decisions.mode: Server-side account management; no payment or client session.
decisions.connectModel: Express connected account owned by the opaque payout owner.
decisions.identity: Opaque owner ID maps to the Payment-private Stripe account ID.
decisions.compatibility: Current B2B payout-account controller and Payment RPCs remain unchanged.

decisions.flow: Create or inspect the saved payout card used by the embedded payout setup flow.
decisions.mode: Save only; off-session usage for a known customer and on-session compatibility when no customer is bound.
decisions.connectModel: Platform customer; setup success never represents money movement.
decisions.identity: Opaque owner ID resolves the Payment-private customer and payment-method IDs.
decisions.compatibility: Existing payout setup response remains unchanged; future sessions expose an explicit setup kind.

decisions.flow: Create the Customer ticket checkout PaymentIntent and its CustomerSession.
decisions.mode: On-session automatic capture with future-use setup.
decisions.connectModel: Current code creates a platform charge; the target contract requires venue on_behalf_of and destination settlement with only the platform fee retained.
decisions.identity: Current compatibility uses the Stripe intent ID; the durable successor uses caller OperationId and Payment AttemptId.
decisions.compatibility: CheckoutSession and current Customer web/mobile 3DS bridge remain intact until their later migration.

decisions.flow: Create the Venue Hire application session that saves the artist payment method.
decisions.mode: On-session confirmation with usage=off_session for later deposit.
decisions.connectModel: Platform customer; no charge is created.
decisions.identity: Current compatibility uses the SetupIntent ID; the durable successor uses operation and attempt identity.
decisions.compatibility: Existing CreateSetupSession RPC and frontend confirmation remain unchanged.

decisions.flow: Create the Door Split or Versus acceptance session that verifies and saves the venue payment method.
decisions.mode: On-session confirmation with usage=off_session; success is verification, not a charge.
decisions.connectModel: Platform customer; no money movement.
decisions.identity: Current compatibility uses the SetupIntent ID; the durable successor uses operation and attempt identity.
decisions.compatibility: Existing CreateVerifySession RPC and frontend confirmation remain unchanged.

decisions.flow: Create, recover, or capture the Flat Fee manual authorization.
decisions.mode: On-session manual capture; requires_capture normalizes to Authorized and expires at capture_before.
decisions.connectModel: Artist connected account is the settlement merchant and payee under the target contract.
decisions.identity: Current compatibility may use the intent ID; the durable successor binds OperationId, AttemptId, revision, and capture deadline.
decisions.compatibility: Existing hold and capture RPCs remain; new code must not discover a hold through the latest-ten search.

decisions.flow: Execute server-confirmed payment, deposit, settlement, or authorization creation through the Payment-owned Stripe seam.
decisions.mode: Presence and capture mode are explicit caller-owned options within Payment.
decisions.connectModel: Destination, on_behalf_of, transfer, and platform-fee fields follow the selected flow; consumer services never set raw Stripe IDs.
decisions.identity: Stripe idempotency derives from the Payment operation/action identity.
decisions.compatibility: Existing payment-manager and financial-operation contracts remain authoritative.

decisions.flow: Release settled funds to the connected-account payee.
decisions.mode: Server-side financial operation; not a client session.
decisions.connectModel: Transfer from the original source transaction to the connected account.
decisions.identity: Existing financial-operation identity and Stripe action idempotency key.
decisions.compatibility: The existing release command boundary remains authoritative.

decisions.flow: Refund a PaymentIntent or charge and reverse transfer value when the original Connect model requires it.
decisions.mode: Server-side financial operation with an independent refund lifecycle.
decisions.connectModel: Reverse destination transfer or issue an explicit transfer reversal according to the original charge model.
decisions.identity: Existing financial-operation ID plus Payment-owned action idempotency.
decisions.compatibility: PR #552 owns B2B adoption and RefundReasonCodes; this baseline does not replace those contracts.

decisions.flow: Verify, deduplicate, and dispatch Stripe webhook observations.
decisions.mode: At-least-once, duplicate, and unordered provider observation.
decisions.connectModel: Payment-private provider data; published events expose only normalized Payment vocabulary.
decisions.identity: Stripe event ID deduplicates transport; operation, attempt, and revision govern state mutation.
decisions.compatibility: Existing PaymentSucceeded and PaymentFailed events remain while the later durable pipeline is added.

decisions.flow: Manage the active tenant payout account through Payment.
decisions.mode: Server-side adapter calls plus an embedded setup client session.
decisions.connectModel: The active B2B tenant is the opaque connected-account owner.
decisions.identity: B2B supplies tenant ID; Payment keeps Stripe account, customer, and method IDs private.
decisions.compatibility: The tenant controller remains unchanged in Phase 1.

decisions.flow: Create or server-confirm the current ticket checkout payment.
decisions.mode: Automatic capture; client confirmation for a new method or server confirmation for a saved method.
decisions.connectModel: Venue is the target settlement merchant/payee; only the platform fee belongs to Concertable.
decisions.identity: Current flow correlates by Stripe intent ID; the later Customer attempt persists OperationId before calling Payment.
decisions.compatibility: No durable Customer attempt or query endpoint is introduced in Phase 1.

decisions.flow: Authorize and later capture the Flat Fee amount.
decisions.mode: On-session manual authorization followed by server capture before expiry.
decisions.connectModel: Artist connected account is payee and settlement merchant.
decisions.identity: Booking/application compatibility IDs remain; the durable successor adds operation and attempt identity.
decisions.compatibility: Existing hold lookup and capture calls remain until the durable session migration.

decisions.flow: Charge the saved artist method for the Venue Hire deposit.
decisions.mode: Off-session server-confirmed automatic capture.
decisions.connectModel: Charge on behalf of the venue connected account and retain escrow ownership until release.
decisions.identity: Booking ID and existing deposit operation identity remain authoritative.
decisions.compatibility: PR #552 owns B2B adoption of the durable deposit command.

decisions.flow: Save the Venue Hire artist method or verify the Door Split/Versus venue method.
decisions.mode: On-session setup with declared off-session reuse.
decisions.connectModel: No money movement; connected-account charge posture is applied only by the later payment.
decisions.identity: Current SetupIntent ID remains compatibility-only; durable operation identity comes later.
decisions.compatibility: The shared frontend still infers SetupIntent from the secret prefix until the later migration.

decisions.flow: Release held escrow funds after the booking finishes.
decisions.mode: Server-side financial operation.
decisions.connectModel: Transfer to the payee from the original source transaction.
decisions.identity: Booking ID resolves the existing Payment-owned escrow and operation receipt.
decisions.compatibility: Existing release command remains authoritative.

decisions.flow: Refund canceled escrow by booking or application.
decisions.mode: Server-side financial operation with its own provider status.
decisions.connectModel: Reversal follows whether funds were still held or already transferred.
decisions.identity: Booking ID resolves the existing Payment-owned escrow and refund receipt.
decisions.compatibility: PR #552 owns B2B refund adoption; Phase 1 does not change it.

decisions.flow: Charge the saved venue method for Door Split or Versus settlement.
decisions.mode: Off-session server-confirmed automatic capture.
decisions.connectModel: Charge and transfer direction follows the typed deal calculation; only the platform fee belongs to Concertable.
decisions.identity: Booking ID and the existing settlement operation remain authoritative.
decisions.compatibility: Existing manager payment RPC remains unchanged.

decisions.flow: Initialize and present PaymentSheet for ticket checkout.
decisions.mode: On-session automatic capture.
decisions.connectModel: Opaque to the app; Payment owns provider and Connect mechanics.
decisions.identity: Current compatibility parses the intent ID from the client secret for SignalR correlation.
decisions.compatibility: Finite PR #581 bridge allowlist; replace with explicit identity and consumer query recovery later.

decisions.flow: Correlate current ticket checkout completion with SignalR.
decisions.mode: On-session automatic capture.
decisions.connectModel: Opaque to the frontend.
decisions.identity: Current compatibility parses the intent ID from the client secret.
decisions.compatibility: Finite PR #581 bridge allowlist; no new client-secret parser is permitted.

decisions.owner: B2B web and Customer web shared checkout
decisions.flow: Confirm the current PaymentIntent or SetupIntent in the shared Stripe form.
decisions.mode: On-session client confirmation; PaymentIntent capture mode comes from the server session.
decisions.connectModel: Opaque to the frontend.
decisions.identity: Current compatibility infers intent kind from the client-secret prefix.
decisions.compatibility: Finite legacy inference allowlist; future descriptors carry explicit session kind.

decisions.owner: B2B web and Customer web shared payment handling
decisions.flow: Complete provider-required next action after a server-confirmed payment.
decisions.mode: On-session authentication continuation.
decisions.connectModel: Opaque to the frontend.
decisions.identity: Current result carries only the client secret; durable operation identity is added later.
decisions.compatibility: Existing handle3ds compatibility island remains until the shared orchestration migration.
